readme:
# TikTok Followers Scraper

Scrape the full follower list of any public [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/) account. Supply one or more usernames and receive a structured dataset of their followers — including username, display name, bio, verified status, follower count, and profile URL. No login required.

## Features

- **Multiple profiles** — scrape followers for several accounts in a single run
- **Pagination** — automatically pages through all followers up to the optional limit
- **No login required** — uses TikTok's public profile and follower endpoints
- **Username or URL input** — accepts bare usernames, `@username`, or full TikTok URLs
- **Challenge detection** — logs a warning and skips accounts that trigger bot-protection pages
- **Per-profile limit** — optionally cap the number of followers returned per account
- **Pay-per-result** — only pay for follower records you receive

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/tiktok-followers-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `tiktok-followers-scraper` to get the first 200 followers of 'charlidamelio'. Return a table showing username, display name, verified status, and follower count."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Data Extracted

| Field | Example |
|-------|---------|
| `source_username` | `"charlidamelio"` |
| `username` | `"khaby.lame"` |
| `display_name` | `"Khabane lame"` |
| `bio` | `"Just a simple guy"` |
| `verified` | `true` |
| `avatar_url` | `"https://p16-sign.tiktokcdn-us.com/..."` |
| `follower_count` | `157000000` |
| `following_count` | `1000` |
| `profile_url` | `"https://www.tiktok.com/@khaby.lame"` |
| `scraped_at` | `"2026-04-29T10:00:00Z"` |

## Pricing

Pay-per-result pricing. You only pay for follower records you receive.

| Event | Price | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| Actor start | $0.25 | One-time container startup fee |
| Follower scraped | $0.50 / 1,000 | Each follower record returned |

**Examples:**
- 1,000 followers = **$0.75** total ($0.25 start + $0.50 results)
- 10,000 followers = **$5.25** total

No monthly fees. No minimum spend.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `profiles` | string[] | TikTok usernames, `@username` handles, or full profile URLs to scrape followers for | — |
| `maxFollowersPerProfile` | integer | Maximum followers to return per profile. `0` means no limit. | `0` |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | Apify proxy settings | Auto |

## Usage Examples

### Scrape followers of a single account

```json
{
  "profiles": ["charlidamelio"],
  "maxFollowersPerProfile": 1000
}
```

### Scrape followers for multiple accounts

```json
{
  "profiles": [
    "https://www.tiktok.com/@charlidamelio",
    "@khaby.lame",
    "mrbeast"
  ],
  "maxFollowersPerProfile": 500,
  "proxyConfiguration": {
    "useApifyProxy": true
  }
}
```

### Unlimited followers (scrapes all)

```json
{
  "profiles": ["somebrand"],
  "maxFollowersPerProfile": 0
}
```

## Output

Results are exported to the default dataset. The **Followers Overview** table view shows source account, username, display name, bio, verified status, follower count, following count, and profile URL.

Export to JSON, CSV, Excel, or connect via the Apify API.

## FAQ

**Which accounts can be scraped?**
Any public TikTok account. Private accounts and accounts that require login to view are not supported.

**What does `follower_count: null` mean?**
The follower record was returned but the stats block was not populated for that user — this can happen for new or very small accounts. The username and profile URL are still valid.

**Can I scrape the full follower list of a large account?**
Yes. Leave `maxFollowersPerProfile` at `0` to scrape without limit. Be aware that accounts with millions of followers may take a long time and incur higher costs.

**Is the follower list in any particular order?**
TikTok returns followers in reverse-chronological order (most recent first). The order may vary slightly depending on the account size and pagination behaviour.

**What happens if TikTok shows a challenge page?**
The actor detects common challenge-page indicators and skips the affected account with an error log entry. Other accounts in the run continue normally.
